objective: Reverificar en solo lectura CIENFUEGOS inmediatamente después de que tempcheques pasó de 14 filas a cero. Confirmar si las cuentas del 19 de octubre de 2026 ya fueron trasladadas a cheques, si el turno fue cerrado y si el conjunto cerrado puede alimentar el resync oficial.
acceptance: Mostrar frescura actual de turnos, cheques y tempcheques
Obtener total, tickets, PAX y propina de cheques por turnos.apertura para 2026-10-19
Listar los tickets cerrados del día operativo 19
Mostrar cierre del turno o turnos abiertos el 19
Cero DDL, cero DML y production_touched=false
constraints: No tocar los sincronizadores de Ventas del dia o Ventas cerradas
No ejecutar resync o backfill en esta fase
No escribir en EDARSAHUB ni POS
Usar la misma ventana transversal 09:00 a 09:00 y turnos.apertura
Mantener enfoque atomico, canonico y transversal
Trabajar solo en Desarrollo y no tocar Produccion

queries.name: cienfuegos_current_freshness_after_close
queries.sql: SELECT DB_NAME() AS database_name,(SELECT MAX(apertura) FROM turnos WITH (NOLOCK)) AS max_turno_apertura,(SELECT MAX(cierre) FROM turnos WITH (NOLOCK)) AS max_turno_cierre,(SELECT MAX(fecha) FROM cheques WITH (NOLOCK)) AS max_cheque_fecha,(SELECT MAX(cierre) FROM cheques WITH (NOLOCK)) AS max_cheque_cierre,(SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) FROM tempcheques WITH (NOLOCK)) AS tempcheques_rows,(SELECT MAX(fecha) FROM tempcheques WITH (NOLOCK)) AS max_tempcheque_fecha;

queries.name: cienfuegos_closed_aggregate_oct19
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ch.folio) AS tickets,CAST(SUM(ISNULL(ch.total,0)) AS decimal(18,2)) AS total,CAST(SUM(ISNULL(ch.propina,0)) AS decimal(18,2)) AS propina,SUM(ISNULL(ch.nopersonas,0)) AS pax,SUM(CASE WHEN ch.cierre IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS tickets_sin_cierre,MIN(tr.apertura) AS apertura_min,MAX(tr.apertura) AS apertura_max,MIN(tr.cierre) AS turno_cierre_min,MAX(tr.cierre) AS turno_cierre_max,MIN(ch.fecha) AS cheque_fecha_min,MAX(ch.fecha) AS cheque_fecha_max,MIN(ch.cierre) AS cheque_cierre_min,MAX(ch.cierre) AS cheque_cierre_max FROM cheques ch WITH (NOLOCK) INNER JOIN turnos tr WITH (NOLOCK) ON tr.idturno=ch.idturno WHERE tr.apertura>='2026-10-19 09:00:00' AND tr.apertura<'2026-10-20 09:00:00' AND ISNULL(ch.cancelado,0)=0;

queries.name: cienfuegos_closed_tickets_oct19
queries.sql: SELECT ch.folio,ch.numcheque,tr.idturno,tr.apertura,tr.cierre AS turno_cierre,ch.fecha,ch.cierre AS cheque_cierre,CAST(ISNULL(ch.total,0) AS decimal(18,2)) AS total,CAST(ISNULL(ch.propina,0) AS decimal(18,2)) AS propina,ISNULL(ch.nopersonas,0) AS pax,ISNULL(ch.cancelado,0) AS cancelado FROM cheques ch WITH (NOLOCK) INNER JOIN turnos tr WITH (NOLOCK) ON tr.idturno=ch.idturno WHERE tr.apertura>='2026-10-19 09:00:00' AND tr.apertura<'2026-10-20 09:00:00' AND ISNULL(ch.cancelado,0)=0 ORDER BY tr.apertura,ch.fecha,ch.folio;

queries.name: cienfuegos_turnos_oct19
queries.sql: SELECT idturno,apertura,cierre FROM turnos WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE apertura>='2026-10-19 09:00:00' AND apertura<'2026-10-20 09:00:00' ORDER BY apertura,idturno;
